verdict.rationale: Square provides a Disputes API to 'Process Disputes' (square-docs-11) and Webhooks (square-docs-12) that could notify merchants of new disputes, covering the core dispute-notification-and-submission workflow. However, evidence is limited to a generic API overview link with no detail on deadline tracking, evidence submission workflow specifics, or Dashboard UI documentation, and no independent/hands-on confirmation of the merchant-facing experience. Missing for 10: documented deadline/notification mechanics, evidence submission UI details, and community or hands-on corroboration of the dispute workflow.
